Definition: a prolonged form of a primary root; to bite, i.e. (figuratively) thwart:--bite.
BiblicalUsage: Paul uses the word once, as a warning to a quarrelling church: if you bite and devour one another, take heed that you are not consumed by one another. The bite is the church turning on itself.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse is a mirror for every congregation: the teeth we use on each other will eat us too.
